entries.note: Yang 2024 (epub 4 Dec 2024) quote verbatim but names the clinical MTD, not the dog margin. Dog NOAEL 6e11 vg/mL (0.07 mL, ~4e10 vg); humans tolerated 6.8e11 vg/eye: the margin cannot be matched. Drug/route/population correct.
entries.adjudication_note: DRAFTER_BRIEF dose table margin_stated row / Decision 16: dog NOAEL 6e11, toxic 3e12 vg/mL (Song/Dufour 2020) is a model-stated margin; HORIZON concentrations (Ophthalmology Times): 1.1e12 vg/mL tolerated, 3.2e12 vg/mL toxic. Margin held.

missing: Botaretigene (bota-vec, AAV5-hRKp.RPGR) has no track although it is a class member with a phase 3 failure: human RPGR-KO iPSC retinal organoids tested the bota-vec clinical construct and said they 'support' the phase I/II results ahead of phase 3 (Sladen 2024, Int J Mol Sci, doi:10.3390/ijms25031839, PMID 38339118); LUMEOS then missed its primary (J&J 5 May 2025; Fierce Biotech). A prospective organoid efficacy entry would score contra in 2025 (engagement readout opsin localisation: not_measured).

Bota-vec phase 1/2 (Michaelides et al. 2024, AJO, doi:10.1016/j.ajo.2024.05.034, PMID 38871269): no dose-limiting events at 1-4x10^11 vg/mL and steroid-responsive ocular inflammation; patient-side data for a bota-vec preclinical track (its own mouse/dog/NHP basis not located).

XLPRA1/XLPRA2 dogs with AAV2/5-hIRBP/hGRK1-hRPGR (Beltran 2012 PNAS, doi:10.1073/pnas.1118847109, PMID 22308428): the original canine proof of concept for subretinal RPGR replacement; check whether it is bota-vec's preclinical basis (AAV5 capsid) and, if so, add it as a track.

Two 2026 meta-analyses of AAV-RPGR trials (J Transl Med doi:10.1186/s12967-026-08709-7; J Clin Med doi:10.3390/jcm15166144) are tier 4 patient-side sources the draft could cite for safety/efficacy pooling.
rule_questions: Dose entry 3 and safety entry 4 score the same dog-predicted top-dose retinal toxicity twice (dose same with margin_stated, safety same). 'Count the harm once' names only the misplaced-margin and unpredicted cases; does a correctly placed, predicted harm belong in dose, safety, or both?
Can a margin stated in vg/mL (dog) be scored against human doses reported only in vg/eye when injection volume is unknown, or must the dose entry stay untested?

Efficacy entry 2 uses the tier 5 press release as src while a tier 1 record (Lam 2024) of the same trial exists with the same status; should src move to the tier 1 record with year kept at the 2021 public date?

RPGR organoid track: the organoids carried the bota-vec hRKp.RPGR cassette in an AAV7m8 capsid, not the clinical AAV5. Does a same-cassette, different-capsid vector count as product_in_model true, or as a sibling drug (false)?

LUMEOS: the sponsor says the VMA maze 'was not sensitive enough' and a secondary PRO improved. Does blaming the endpoint's sensitivity fall under 'attributes the result to conditions the model never tested' (untested), or does a primary miss stay contra?
